verdict.rationale:
Workable's own AI agent is described as running the top-of-funnel sourcing, screening and qualifying process autonomously and handing off a ready shortlist, and this can be paired with webhooks/API/MCP for further automation triggers. However, evidence is limited to marketing copy and API docs with no independent or hands-on confirmation of unattended background operation, scheduling, or failure handling.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the agent running unsupervised over time, details on configuring triggers/schedules for background automations.
